title: Choose ARTHSCAN's visual world
question: The roll assigned the Pink Paper market page. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pink Paper market page
options.lineage: Salmon-stock Indian business dailies and their stock-listing pages
options.thesis: Arthscan as the day's market edition: salmon newsprint, dense ruled listings, and a front page that tells you what happened in one line.
materials: salmon newsprint as the whole ground
condensed headline grotesque with a Devanagari अर्थ masthead
options.viewport: Masthead with edition date and index strip; a three-column front page: the day's headline in plain words, the 3D Nifty 100 city as the lead photograph, and gainers, losers and FII/DII as listings.
options.risk: Newspaper pastiche if the city and live data feel like decoration rather than the front page doing its job; salmon must hold contrast for long reading.

raised.raise: Every figure carries its ticket: source and as-of time printed beside it, like a dateline.
Density courage: listings pages run as tight as a real stock table, ruled, not padded into cards.
Gainers and losers mirror about one axis, so up and down are read as one picture.
The screener previews a strip of matching stocks as each filter is set, before you commit.
Live ticks ripple outward from the stock that moved, through the city and the listings.

options.label: Security print
options.lineage: Indian banknotes and pre-demat engraved share certificates
options.thesis: Every share is a certificate of ownership: intaglio lines, guilloche rosettes drawn from live data, denomination colours as the palette.
options.viewport: One certificate filling the page: a serial line, the claim in engraved capitals, and a data rosette on the right.
options.risk: Ornament can swamp dense data pages, and engraved capitals read slowly on phones.

options.label: Market Lexicon
options.lineage: Nineteenth-century lexicon page with shoulder notes and colour plates
options.thesis: Every company an entry; plain-English glosses run in the shoulder; colour lives only inside chart plates.
options.viewport: Guide words naming the companies in view, a shoulder index, entries in a column, and the city as a bordered plate.
options.case: Wins on clarity (the shoulder is where explanations live) but Indian beginners know the pink papers far better than a Victorian lexicon.
options.risk: Reads as an antique book; cream plus serif is close to the generic AI look.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.lineage: photo darkroom stations under amber light
options.thesis: Research as developing a print, station by station.
options.viewport: Stations in a row; the chosen stock develops into view.
options.case: Beginners do not see themselves in a darkroom, and amber hurts number legibility.
options.kept: Test strips: preview results before committing a filter.

options.label: Ebru floated pigment
options.lineage: Turkish marbling on a liquid bath
options.thesis: The market as pigment displacing on water.
options.viewport: A marbled field reacting to prices.
options.case: Beautiful but unreadable as data; no Indian investor association.
options.risk: Art piece, not a research tool.
options.kept: Motion as displacement outward from the stock that moved.

options.label: Moon-shadow bazaar
options.thesis: Stocks as goods in a moonlit lane.
options.viewport: A lane of stalls, one per sector.
options.case: Whimsy undercuts the trust investors and incubators need.
options.kept: Every item carries a ticket of origin: source and time on each figure.

options.label: Versailles vistas
options.case: Foreign to the audience and grandiose for a beginner tool.
options.kept: Mirrored symmetry: gainers and losers about one axis.

options.label: Japanese high-density web
options.thesis: Pack every module onto one screen.
options.case: Overwhelms beginners and recreates the boxed look the user rejected.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white fintech app with one green accent, the way Groww and Tickertape look, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and button beside a chart card, index tiles below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
